intro: Connect the four systems. Watch the scary-looking stock shortage pull blame onto the supplier, and decide for yourself whether the carrier's 'KESTREL COMPONENTS LIMITED' is the supplier master's 'Kestrel Components Ltd.'
finale: Not the supplier and not the port: an invoice HS code that didn't match the packing list. The supplier was only cleared once you merged two systems' names for it. In this pack the merge is load-bearing.
